amendments.issue: The initial outcome-informed config recorded exact Qwen chat-template length statistics but did not hash the standalone tokenizer audit artifact.
amendments.verification: A no-generation preflight with the pinned Qwen tokenizer reproduced 30/30 examples within 8,127-8,524 tokens and the declared prefix/mid-context strata.
amendments.handling: Record and hash the tokenizer audit before any outcome-informed model cell launches; do not alter the dataset or registered model cells.

amendments.issue: A pre-run static audit found that the generic Authority wrapper used a uniform compression-ratio budget, whereas official PyramidKV uses a layer-specific pyramid budget.
amendments.verification: The official pinned PyramidKV compress method calls get_layer_budget for every layer; the retention diagnostic already reproduced that rule, but the not-yet-run Authority upgrade path did not.
amendments.handling: Use an isolated layer-budget-aware Authority wrapper for all outcome-informed cells, add exact unit tests for fixed and layer-specific budgets, hash the new source, and leave every frozen preregistered source and completed result unchanged.

amendments.issue: The registered 2% V1/V2 comparison required a formal preflight proving that the protected authority span actually exceeds each base method's budget.
amendments.verification: Exact Qwen tokenization found 189-271 protected tokens versus 162-170 fixed-budget tokens; all 30 examples also exceeded the pinned PyramidKV budget in all 28 layers.
amendments.handling: Add a hashed, fail-closed extreme-budget audit to the queue before any model cell. The registered dataset, model, methods, budgets, gates, and reporting rules remain unchanged.

amendments.issue: The long-context branch needed the same detector/provenance separation audit used for the parent controlled datasets.
amendments.verification: On the frozen 30-example stress set, detector-v3 covered 25/25 conflicts, fired on 0/5 benign examples, covered every low-authority span, and had zero overlap with protected tokens; provenance also had zero protected overlap.
amendments.handling: Add the unchanged detector audit script and its fail-closed invocation to the outcome-informed manifest. This is a controlled-template coverage check, not a natural-traffic accuracy claim.

amendments.issue: The registered extreme-budget branch compared strict and adaptive Authority variants but did not include the official 2% controls or a deliberately wrong-authority intervention.
amendments.verification: No outcome-informed model cell had started. The original SnapKV, TOVA, and PyramidKV papers explicitly target long-context robustness and report near-FullKV behavior at aggressive compression, so a 20%/40% short-context zero effect requires a capacity-threshold and causal-selection diagnosis rather than a boundary label alone.
amendments.handling: At the already registered 8k/2% condition, add all three official bases and matched adaptive wrong-authority controls. The wrong control protects the registered low-authority span and demotes the governing high-authority span on conflicts, while reducing exactly to the official scorer on benign examples. Preserve all original V1/V2 cells and budgets.

motivation: The completed Qwen official cells showed exact FullKV-equivalent outputs for SnapKV, TOVA, and PyramidKV at 20% and 40% retention. This follow-up diagnoses that boundary and tests a separately labeled budget-adaptive upgrade; it is not part of the preregistered main matrix.

zero_signal_audit.finding: Compression was active at the requested ratios, all cells were error-free, and the paper names mapped to distinct pinned official press classes; saved outputs alone cannot reveal retained-index overlap.

integrity_rules: Never overwrite, merge, or relabel a parent or preregistered follow-up run.
Label every result from this file as outcome-informed.
Preserve zero effects, infeasible cells, runtime errors, and failed gates.
Do not treat synthetic stress results as natural-traffic prevalence or an official AgentDojo result.
Promote the adaptive variant only if the complete registered comparison supports the claim; otherwise report it as a negative optimization attempt.

measurements: system, developer, combined high-authority, typed-low, detected-low, and provenance-untrusted retention

long_context_stress.budget_fidelity: Every Authority variant preserves the base press's layer-specific cache budget when defined (including PyramidKV); otherwise it uses the base compression-ratio budget. Only token priorities and the registered V1/V2 over-subscription policy change.

extreme_budget_upgrade_after_gate.preflight_requirement: All 30 examples must over-subscribe the fixed scorer budget and every pinned PyramidKV layer budget at 2% retention; otherwise no outcome-informed model cell launches.
extreme_budget_upgrade_after_gate.v2_change: When typed high-authority tokens exceed the base method's layer budget, keep the base-score-best protected subset under the same protected/excluded lexicographic offsets instead of declaring the cell infeasible.
extreme_budget_upgrade_after_gate.causal_control: Compare the correct adaptive intervention with a wrong-authority intervention that protects the _low_ conflict span and demotes the _high_ governing span. The control uses no intervention on benign examples.

required: Holm correction across the registered pairwise family
reporting.claim_rule: The adaptive upgrade may support only a graceful extreme-budget feasibility claim unless it also improves hierarchy success with no material benign-utility loss. A causal authority-selection claim additionally requires the correct intervention to outperform the wrong-authority control on complete paired conflicts without a benign-utility confound.
